summary: Former Sullivan County, PA lookout: a 60-foot Blaw-Knox tower from 1923, removed in August 1989. A cell tower now stands on or near the site.

facts.design: 60-foot Blaw-Knox steel tower from 1923; a 1958 survey describes a cabin atop a four-legged steel structure
facts.status_note: Removed in August 1989. Undated passages of a visit report on the register say a large cell tower now stands on or near the site.

access.note: Only source is a 1984 visit report: the visitor asked a private landowner's permission to park and hike up. No current access statement found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia's mountain article uses the present tense for the fire tower. The register gives removal in August 1989, and a visit report from 1984 describes the tower as out of service. The story follows the register.

notes_for_editor: The story rests on the register page with its 1984 visit report, a 1958 Coast and Geodetic Survey description quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, and Wikipedia for the conflict only. A search result from an East Lycoming Historical Society Facebook post gives a different sequence for 1920-1923 (first tower removed in 1923; second built in 1923 by the Department of Forestry and later destroyed by wind and ice). The page would not open, so it is not used; check before publishing. The visit report is dated August 15, 1984 but mentions geocaching photos, so it was probably written later; the cabin and cell-tower statements are undated. Access rests on that one report, and no current access statement was found. No correction proposed.
